TextView.android:text: A one-time setup so Android Auto can project to your CFMoto dash, plus display and battery options.
Android Auto runs Maps/Waze. OpenCfMoto relays its screen to the bike.
Camera (scan the dash QR), Location (join the bike Wi-Fi), Notifications (keep running while you ride).
In Android Auto settings, tap "Version" ~10 times to unlock Developer settings, then turn ON "Add new cars to Android Auto" / "Unknown sources". (Can't be checked automatically.)
Fill — edge to edge (crops a little)
Inset Android Auto from each edge of the dash (top / bottom / left / right). Useful on 800NK Advanced for the MotoPlay pull-down.

Auto fits recognized CFMoto dashes. If your bike's screen is a different shape (e.g. a tall portrait display) or isn't recognized, pick the orientation + size that matches it. Android Auto supports only these fixed sizes, so Screen fit above decides how it's placed (Fill crops, Fit adds bars, Stretch distorts). HD is sharper but heavier and can black-screen on some dashes — drop to a smaller size or Auto if so.
Off — use the bike profile (touch dashes stay touch)
Turn On if handlebar buttons do nothing: Android Auto runs in focus/knob mode (no touchscreen advertised) so ▲/▼/Enter work. Needed next Connect — Stop first if you're already projecting.
Off — use the bike profile (1000 MT‑X stays focus/knob)

Turn On for a touch panel on a focus/knob profile (e.g. 1000 MT‑X): Android Auto advertises a touchscreen so you can tap the dash. Turns off Disable touchscreen. Unlock the bike's own touch lock if needed. Applies next Connect — Stop first if you're already projecting.
This app runs a live video transcoder — it always draws power and warms the phone. Keep it on the bike's USB charger, and turn the phone screen OFF while riding (projection keeps running).
Use Legacy for CFDL16 / 450SR-style non-touch dashes if Auto picks the wrong bike. 800NK Adv = CFDL26 touch 720×712. Applies next Connect (Stop first if projecting).
The dash sends the handlebar volume/track/call buttons over Bluetooth — not the mirroring link. Pair your phone to the bike (as a phone/audio device) and they control Android Auto media and calls.
When a paired bike's Wi-Fi is in range, start projecting automatically.
If the dash drops or projection stalls, reconnect automatically — no Stop/Start.
Record each ride's route and stats from GPS while projecting. View them under Trip ▸ Saved trips.

Let the app re-project on its own when the bike comes back, even with the screen off or the phone in a bag. Needs the “Display over other apps” permission; otherwise you'll get a tap-to-resume notification instead.
Auto — AP when the QR advertises it, else Wi‑Fi Direct
Off — passwords and serials are redacted (recommended)
Export bike tuning only — profile, resolution, fit, margins, buttons, Wi‑Fi transport (no passwords, no personal prefs). Share on Discord so others can Import.
